name: [⛄] Mushroom Incremental
desc:
🍄 Guide on Mushroom Incremental🍄 

🌲 Collect Mushrooms on your own field and trade them for powerful upgrades!
🧈 Rejoin the game to claim offline rewards for a perfect boost!
👥 Invite friends to get a luck boost!
✨ Discover rare mushrooms and boost your strength even further
📈 Progress through unique stages to unlock special upgrades.
🏆 Max out your land and rise to become the #1 Mushroom picker!
🎁PLAYTIME REWARDS
- Stay active in game to collect some nice prizes! You can get Mushrooms, Rebirths, and even Diamonds!

👍 Drop a like and favourite the game to support future updates.

🔔 Join our community server for update logs, sneak peeks, and leaks!
